name: Tax Increment Financing (TIF) Annual Report - Job and Increment Creation

columns.name: TIF Number
columns.description: The unique, numeric ID assigned to the TIF district.

columns.name: Report Year
columns.description: Calendar year to which the record applies.

columns.name: Redevelopment Agreement
columns.description: Legal name of the agreement executed by the City of Chicago.

columns.name: Jobs Projected (Temporary)
columns.description: The temporary (i.e. construction, part-time, etc.) number of jobs projected to be created during construction of the project

columns.name: Jobs Projected (Permanent)
columns.description: The permanent (i.e. full-time) number of jobs projected to be created or retained at some time during the term of the RDA

columns.name: Jobs Actual (Temporary)
columns.description: The temporary (i.e. construction, part-time, etc.) number of jobs created during the construction of the project

columns.name: Jobs Actual (Permanent)
columns.description: The permanent (i.e. full-time) number of jobs created or retained at some time during the term of the RDA

columns.name: Increment Projected
columns.description: The increment projected to be created at the time of approval of the redevelopment agreement.  Blanks indicate that the number is not available.

columns.name: Increment Actual
columns.description: Actual amount of increment created during the report year.  Blanks indicate that the number is not available.
